cards.name: Revelation of Crying Chaos

effects.lua_implementation: AddSynchroProcedure enforces a Zombie Tuner and one or more non-Tuners.

official_references.official_effect_text:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 2 "White Forest" monsters in your GY; place them face-up in their owners' Spell & Trap Zones as Continuous Spells. During your opponent's Main Phase, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon using this card you control. You can only use each effect of "Poplar of the White Forest" once per turn.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is Synchro Summoned using a Zombie Synchro Monster: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Zombie monster from your Deck or GY.
effects.lua_implementation: e1 checks the material group for a Zombie Synchro and summons a Level 4-or-lower Zombie from Deck/GY.

official_references.official_effect_text:
2 Effect Monsters
If this card is Link Summoned using a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster as material: [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 card on the field or in either GY; [b]banish[/b] it, [b]also[/b] your monsters [b]cannot[/b] attack directly this turn. [b]When[/b] your opponent activates a card or effect ([b]Quick Effect[/b]): [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 2 face-up monsters on the field, including a monster you control; [b]banish[/b] both until the [b]End Phase[/b]. [b]You can[/b] only use each effect of "S:P Little Knight" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].

effects.printed_clause: When your opponent activates a card or effect that would make a card you control leave the field (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 "Crying Chaos" monster you control; Negate that effect, and if you do, this card gains ATK equal to the Tributed monster's combined ATK and DEF until the end of this turn.
effects.lua_implementation: negcon recognizes the standard leave-field operation-info categories; negcost Tributes a Crying Chaos monster and stores its current GetAttack()+GetDefense(); negop negates and applies that value through the End Phase.

official_references.official_effect_text: If this card is in your hand or GY (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 "@Ignister" monster; Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. When a card or effect is activated that targets a Cyberse monster(s) you control, and you control a Cyberse monster that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; negate that effect. You can only use each effect of "Kurikurinku @Ignister" once per turn.

Activate this card by targeting 1 face-up Attack Position monster on the field; that face-up monster [b]cannot[/b] be destroyed by battle or your opponent's card effects, your opponent [b]cannot[/b] [b]target[/b] it with card effects, [b]also[/b] it [b]cannot[/b] attack your opponent directly. [b]When[/b] this card leaves the field, [b]destroy[/b] that monster. [b]When[/b] that monster leaves the field, [b]destroy[/b] this card.

effects.issue: Omega can inspect declared operation-info categories and chain targets, but arbitrary Lua operations need not declare either, so the engine cannot determine every effect that would make a controlled card leave the field. Exact resolution requires an engine API exposing the resolving operation's affected cards/destinations, or card text restricted to declared targets and enumerated leave-field categories.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each effect of "Revelation of Crying Chaos" once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: e1/e2 use distinct id/id+1 hard limits.

official_references.official_effect_text: If your opponent controls 2 or more monsters, [b]you can[/b] Special Summon this card (from your hand). [b]You can[/b] only Special Summon "Moon Gardna" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b] this way. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned [b]and[/b] your opponent controls a monster: [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 Level 4 LIGHT monster in your GY, except "Moon Gardna"; add it to your hand. [b]You can[/b] only use this effect of "Moon Gardna" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].
